metadata.description: Tierwise: the right model for every step of your Claude Code work.

plugins.name: tierwise
plugins.description: Gives every step of your Claude Code work to the model it needs: Fable for plans and hard judgement, Opus for security-sensitive code and review, Sonnet and Haiku for the volume. Enforces the routing at every spawn, runs the checks a change needs before it can finish, and shows what you saved.
